The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with quantity 0. The full `mvn -q -o test` run finished with exit code 0 and no output. I didn't add a test for the new behavior.

The change is one condition, `AND s.quantity > 0`, added to the query in `DataStore.listStockByWarehouse` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, around line 1491). In your example, WH-1 now lists only "Bolt 10". The single-product quantity lookup uses a different query, which I left alone, so asking for the nuts in WH-1 still returns 0.

I haven't committed anything.
